summary: Full E2E validation of the new Analytics & Growth module (Faza 1). Backend: 15/15 pytest pass covering public tracker (/api/track, /api/track/config), campaign shortlink redirect (/api/go/{code}) including 302→/?c={code}&utm_source=… + via_qr=1, nonexistent code fallback → 302 /, admin CRUD on growth_campaigns, QR PNG generation (magic bytes verified), overview/pages/CSV export for report=overview|pages|campaigns across periods day|week|month, integrations GET/PUT with G-TEST123 round-trip and reset, and unauthenticated admin endpoints correctly return 401/403. Frontend: homepage visitor writes pm_vid in localStorage, POSTs /api/track twice, fetches /api/track/config, and Microsoft Clarity script (clarity.ms) is injected with window.clarity=function within ~4s. Super-admin login → /admin/analytics-growth: 6 KPI cards render (VIZITATORI UNICI, SESIUNI, CONTURI CREATE, SPECIALIȘTI ÎNSCRIȘI, PROPRIETĂȚI ADĂUGATE, BOUNCE RATE), Trafic-zilnic area chart, Surse-trafic pie chart, Funnel bar chart, period switching (Azi/7 zile/30 zile) all work, ag-refresh works. Pagini tab renders ag-pages-table + CSV export button. Campanii tab: created 'Camp QA Test iter82', got shortcode i0p60w, all 9 indicators shown (Primit/Deschis/Vizitatori/30s+/Început înreg./Conturi/Abonamente/Revenit 7z/Conversie), QR icon link, deleted successfully. Integrări tab: Clarity precompleted with 'xj5fspkgjj', saved G-TEST123 → confirmed via /api/track/config → reset to ''. Admin nav item admin-nav-growth_analytics is present under STATISTICI & KPI. No console errors related to the module (401s were unrelated pre-login admin polls from other tabs).

minor.issue: Returns only fields that were persisted (e.g. missing ga4_id/meta_pixel_id keys until first PUT). Frontend handles this with `integrations[kk] || ""` so no user impact, but consider always returning the 4 canonical keys (clarity_id, ga4_id, meta_pixel_id, tracker_enabled) for a more predictable API surface.

action_items: (Optional) Normalize /api/admin/analytics/integrations to always return the 4 canonical keys (clarity_id, ga4_id, meta_pixel_id, tracker_enabled), even before first PUT. Non-blocking.
(Optional soft) analytics_growth.py is 513 LOC — still under the 700 LOC guideline, but future funnel/heatmap work could split settings/campaigns/analytics into 3 sub-modules for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: analytics_growth.py:170-177 — /api/go/{code} for a nonexistent code returns 302 → "/" (bare path). This is fine for same-origin, but if the tracker script is loaded on a different host it could redirect off-site. Current behaviour is intentional per spec (no crash on inexistent campaign). No fix needed unless spec changes.

analytics_growth.py:104-107 — Admin paths filtered via prefix check `path.startswith('/admin')`; consider centralizing this list or making it configurable if you later add other 'internal' paths (e.g. /debug, /health) so ops traffic isn't polluting analytics.

analytics.js:190-194 — /api/track/config is fetched with a bare fetch (no timeout/abort). If the endpoint hangs during a network incident, the injectClarity/GA4/Meta injections never fire but the tracker itself still works. Acceptable graceful degradation.

AnalyticsGrowthPage.jsx:51 — useEffect keyed on [period] and load references axios/API in closure. Fine as-is because load is defined inside the component; eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps is applied correctly.

analytics_growth.py:250-267 — Campaign code uses secrets.token_urlsafe(4).replace('_','x').replace('-','z')[:6] — collision probability is low but there is no uniqueness check on insert. Consider adding a retry-on-duplicate or a unique index on `code` (currently the collection likely doesn't enforce it).
